description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Moseo, adding {C}{C}.
When Moseo dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Moseo from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Moseo enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
